comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening limit; PR-1572 safely routes a curved board edge using a starting pin and bearing-guided bit.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses seated hand tools and coordinated countertorque; PR-1572 braces and pivots a free board onto a bearing, then feeds its curve in the safe direction while maintaining cutter clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades angle accuracy, lock retention, cyclic return and drift; PR-1572 grades routed length, safe pin-mediated entry, feed direction, hand exclusion and final cutter clearance. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Guided curved-stock feeding around a cutting hazard does not exercise threaded stop adjustment or locknut-induced setting preservation.
